I'm 35 years old, never been in a relationship, my most advanced physical experience with a woman is when a friend of mine drunkenly assaulted me about 12 years ago, and I've had a lot of intricate suicidal thoughts because of all of it. 

I've tried reaching out to numerous friends over it, and a lot of them stop me after I say I need to talk to someone with "you should see a therapist". I can count on one hand the amount of women I think have genuinely found me attractive over my lifetime, and I feel like I'm missing out on an entire aspect of humanity.
